author: TheHobbitsEnd
body:
Criteria:

  • Must have at least three days of play time.

  • Must be applying for a moderator position.

  • Must not be banned on any Avicus platform.

  • Must speak fluent English

  • Must be active on all Avicus platforms (in-game, Teamspeak, Forums and Discord)


Age:

Timezone: Central Timezone or CT

Do you have Teamspeak? I have Teamspeak but sometimes i'm not active on it so i'm always on discord.

Do you have Discord?Yes.

Do you have access to a recording software?I have OBS and Ispring cam



CRITERIA 1: SELF REFLECTION/EVALUATION


Do you have any experience as a moderator on other servers? No i haven't but i'm sure i will be a great one.


What is your biggest weakness and how will it affect your moderating? Staff Disrespect if they make me mad i will try to work it out, if they don't stop i will get a higher staff to warn them.


What qualities do you think a leader must have?INSPIRATION,PASSION,MOTIVATION and most importantly RESPECT! Would you consider yourself a leader?Yes i do Why/why not? i try really hard at sports,band i work hard all the time i just want to be something in this server so everyone knows me and they think im a great mod.


What attributes distinguish yourself from other players that qualify you to be a moderator? inactive mods.


What skills do you believe you should have when interacting with the community? Being nice,patience,passion i have respect to all moderators! Do you believe you have these skills?yes i do especially patience's golf keeps me patience.


What in your opinion are the three main character traits a moderator must have when moderating? mods catching hackers >.<,respecting players and staff,DONT TROLL.



CRITERIA 2: GENERAL SITUATIONS


You notice a moderator giving out a lot of false bans. They almost always have insufficient evidence or sometimes no evidence and they don’t seem to care. You notice it but other staff members don’t. What would you do? record everything or screenshot and i will stand up even though he/she might be a higher rank than me i will do everything i can to get him demoted idc if i get demoted i just want that player to meet his end to his moderating days in the Avicus community


You are in Teamspeak with a few other players and they begin talking quite disrespectfully about a particular staff member. You agree with what they’re saying to an extent, but the conversation starts to become racial and very disrespectful soon after. You are all in a nightclub channel where this is allowed. What would you do? hmmm im gonna HAVE TO LET IT SLIDE but i might report them if they go wayy too farr with this racial and disrespect stuff.



You are in an Avicus team. One of your teammates is also an Avicus Staff member. One day in your team discord the team member/staff member posts a screenshot of a thread that only staff members can see. The content in the screenshot isn’t very important/confidential but only staff members could see it on the forums. If anything, what would you do? i dont know what i would do i would do something if its something about me cause i wouldn't like that if it was me or anyone else.



Some senior staff members are in teamspeak joking around with each other. They are removing others ranks, creating certain channels and even harassing certain users. They don’t mean any harm but some players in the channel feel a bit angry that they are using their permissions the way they are. What would you do?ohhh i will GET AN ADMIN something higher than their rank im gonna record it or screenshot it and if they remove my rank they gonna get it >:(



CRITERIA 3: OTHER

NOTE: This is a new criteria and these questions are less to do with right/wrong answer and more to do with us getting to know you. Please answer these honestly. There is no right or wrong answer.



Why do you want to be a moderator? I want to help avicus with hackers im always active and when moderators are offline i will always be there.


What does Avicus mean to you? avicus is life i love it here i finally have respect here i love avicus more than anything.


Anything specific the staff team could do better? better maps to try out and all that i want to see a globe map...


Why did you choose to apply at Avicus? its been a couple months i want a little more respect from staff and im doing it for the avicus community.


Do you have anything else to add to your application? nope thats all hope you accept me to Jr.Mod this is hobbit peace.
